memories.page_desc: Browse, search, and manage the long-term memories that shape NPC behavior.
memories.delete_confirm: Delete this memory? Any associated embedding will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
memories.field_events_hint: Comma-separated list of numeric event IDs.
memories.content_placeholder: Describe the memory content in detail…
memories.clear_all_body: This will permanently delete every memory and its embedding. This cannot be undone.
memories.recall_desc: Run a query against the memory index and see which memories would be recalled, ranked by similarity.
memories.generate_started: Memory generation started. This may take a moment.
memories.reembed.state.paused_loading: Re-embedding paused while the game loads
memories.reembed.state.waiting_for_model: Re-embedding is waiting for the embedding model
memories.reembed.state.retrying: Re-embedding hit an error and will try again
memories.reembed.desc: Memories are being re-indexed for search after an update or a model change. Characters recall only the memories already done; the rest return as this runs. You can keep playing.
memories.reembed.desc_stopped: Re-embedding stopped before it finished. It continues the next time a save is loaded.
memories.reembed.unembeddable: {{n}} memories could not be embedded and are left out of recall. Editing a memory's text makes it try again.
